node.statement: The scale table gives 0<=t_2<=W.e_s2, while lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger supplies W.e_s2<=min\{e_s2^0,e_2\} and the remaining fixed-witness inequalities required by lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension. Apply that result to the datum to obtain u_2:M_{|U|+1}->A_R as an extended D_2*t_2-isomorphism with its raw unit estimate; the Stage-2 producer clause of lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger records this same literal map as an extended D_*t_2-isomorphism satisfying ||u_2(I)-u_{A_R}||<=D_*t_2 and eligible for lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation.
